components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default/primary action button — inverted-ink fill, used for the main action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: hsl(222.2, 47.4%, 11.2%); color: hsl(210, 40%, 98%); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: hsla(222.2, 47.4%, 11.2%, 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(210,40%,98%), 0 0 0 4px hsl(222.2, 84%, 4.9%); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid hsl(214.3, 31.8%, 91.4%); border-radius: 6px; background: hsl(210, 40%, 98%); color: hsl(222.2, 47.4%, 11.2%); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: hsl(210, 40%, 96.1%); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(210,40%,98%), 0 0 0 4px hsl(222.2, 84%, 4.9%); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis inline action, e.g. "Edit" beside a word headword.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: hsl(222.2, 47.4%, 11.2%); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: hsl(210, 40%, 96.1%); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Default text field, with optional trailing icon slot (used for the site search box).
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid hsl(214.3, 31.8%, 91.4%); border-radius: 6px; background: hsl(210, 40%, 98%); color: hsl(222.2, 47.4%, 11.2%); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: hsl(215.4, 16.3%, 46.9%); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(210,40%,98%), 0 0 0 4px hsl(222.2, 84%, 4.9%); }

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: Sticky global nav: circular logo mark + wordmark, search, auth state.
components.html: Conlang Dictionary
components.css: .ds-nav { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; width: 100%; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; background: hsl(210, 40%, 98%); border-bottom: 1px solid hsl(214.3, 31.8%, 91.4%); } .ds-nav-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-nav-mark { display: inline-block; width: 2.25rem; height: 2.25rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(210, 40%, 96.1%); outline: 1px solid hsl(214.3, 31.8%, 91.4%); } .ds-nav-word { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; color: hsl(222.2, 47.4%, 11.2%); } .ds-nav-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; } .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid hsl(214.3, 31.8%, 91.4%); border-radius: 6px; background: hsl(210, 40%, 98%); color: hsl(222.2, 47.4%, 11.2%); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Feature Tile
components.description: Signature homepage component — icon-led promo tile on a Mist background, used for the feature grid.
components.html:
Grow Your Dictionary

Build your language's lexicon, grammar, and phonological inventory.
components.css: .ds-tile { border-radius: 12px; background: hsl(210, 40%, 96.1%); padding: 1.5rem; } .ds-tile-icon { margin-bottom: 1rem; height: 3rem; width: 3rem; border-radius: 8px; background: hsl(0, 0%, 100%); padding: 0.5rem; color: hsla(20, 100%, 50%, 0.8); } .ds-tile-title { margin-bottom: 1rem; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: hsl(222.2, 47.4%, 11.2%); } .ds-tile-body { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: hsl(215.4, 16.3%, 46.9%); }

components.name: Notice Banner
components.description: Dismissible in-product alert — currently the only semantic-color usage outside the token system (raw Tailwind yellow).
components.html: Notice: Word sections were recently updated.
components.css: .ds-notice { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.5rem; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #fde68a; background: #fefce8; color: #713f12; padding: 1rem; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-notice-dismiss { border: 1px solid #fde68a; border-radius: 6px; background: #fef9c3; color: #713f12; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; }

narrative.overview:
Conlang Dictionary reads as the reference work it's trying to become: the structural seriousness of Wiktionary — categorized definitions, pronunciation, etymology, custom fields, all per word — rebuilt for a screen a hobbyist actually wants to open on their phone. The system is quiet by design: a near-monochrome slate-and-paper surface carries almost all of the interface, so that the one saturated color in the whole app — Signal Orange — reads as a mark, not decoration. Nothing about the visual language claims more finish than the product has; this is an honest early-alpha reference tool, not a polished consumer product wearing a Wiktionary costume.

Mobile-first is structural, not cosmetic: the top nav collapses its search field into an icon button under `md`, the homepage feature grid drops from three columns to one, and layout decisions default to stacking before they default to arranging side-by-side.
keyCharacteristics: Cool, low-saturation slate/paper neutrals carry ~95% of every screen
One warm, saturated accent (Signal Orange) used only for brand marks and rare emphasis — never for general UI chrome
Flat surfaces, hairline borders instead of shadows — depth comes from background-color steps (paper → mist → ink), not elevation
Heroicons-style 1.5px outline icons for editorial/marketing content, Lucide icons for functional UI controls
Mobile-first responsive rules throughout, not a desktop layout patched down

rules.name: The One Mark Rule
rules.body: Signal Orange appears in at most one or two places per screen — a wordmark, a single banner tint. If a screen has more than one orange element competing for attention, that's a violation, not a stylistic choice.

dos: Do keep Signal Orange to one or two touches per screen (see The One Mark Rule).
Do default new layouts to stacked/mobile behavior first, then widen — this product's mobile-first commitment is a product principle, not just a media query habit.
Do use background-color steps (Paper/Mist/Surface/Ink) to convey grouping and depth before reaching for a shadow.
Do keep marketing/editorial icon needs on the hand-authored Heroicons-outline set, and functional UI icon needs on Lucide.
donts: Don't use Signal Orange as a general interactive color (links, buttons, active states) — it is a brand mark, not a UI accent.
Don't add drop shadows reflexively; the system is currently flat by (unconfirmed) default — introducing elevation is a deliberate design decision for a future pass, not a one-off.

Don't present incomplete or "coming soon" functionality (e.g. rule enforcement, inflection generation) with the same visual finish as shipped features — the product is genuinely early-alpha and the UI shouldn't oversell it.
Don't invent a second semantic-alert color family beyond Alarm; fold the existing yellow-notice pattern into the token system rather than adding a third ad hoc one.
